transcript: Speaker A: यह कहानी है संजीव की जो नोएडा में कंस्ट्रक्शन साइट पर काम करता था। एक दिन विदेशी इंजीनियर के पूछने पर वह इंग्लिश न बोल पाने के कारण जवाब नहीं दे पाया और प्रमोशन खो दिया। उसने 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड किया और ₹1 के ट्रायल से रोज़ प्रैक्टिस की। एक महीने बाद उसने इंजीनियर को इंग्लिश में जवाब दिया और साइट सुपरवाइजर बन गया। [This is the story of Sanjeev, who worked at a construction site in Noida. One day, when a foreign engineer asked him a question, he couldn't answer due to his lack of English and lost a promotion. He downloaded the 'English Seekho' app and practiced daily with a ₹1 trial. A month later, he answered the engineer in English and became the site supervisor.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer]
summary: The ad narrates the story of Sanjeev, a construction worker who misses a promotion because he cannot speak English. He uses the 'English Seekho' app's 1-rupee trial to practice daily with an AI coach, eventually earning a promotion to site supervisor. The video ends with a call to action to download the app.
